data.name: ExtractMethodName_Empty
data.value: The new procedure needs a name.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_NotAnIdentifier
data.value: '{0}' is not a name: a name is a letter, then letters, digits and underscores.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_Reserved
data.value: '{0}' is a keyword of the language: nothing can be named '{0}'.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_TooLong
data.value: A name is at most {3} characters long.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_Collision
data.value: '{0}' already names {1} at {2}.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_Rebinds
data.value: '{0}' at {2} means {1}: it would mean the new procedure instead.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_Shadows
data.value: '{0}' is also {1}, which the new procedure hides in this module.

data.name: ExtractMethodName_Implemented
data.value: {1} implements this class: it would have to implement a Public '{0}' too. Make the new procedure Private.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_NotAParameter
data.value: '{0}' is not a parameter of the new procedure, or it is answered twice.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_Empty
data.value: The parameter '{0}' needs a name.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_NotAnIdentifier
data.value: '{1}' is not a name: a name is a letter, then letters, digits and underscores.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_Reserved
data.value: '{1}' is a keyword of the language: nothing can be named '{1}'.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_TooLong
data.value: A name is at most {2} characters long.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_Duplicate
data.value: Two parameters are named '{1}'.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_Collision
data.value: The new procedure already names something '{1}': the parameter '{0}' cannot take that name.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_NotKnownWhereWritten
data.value: The selection names '{0}' in code whose meaning is not known: '{0}' cannot be renamed.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_NotAPassing
data.value: '{1}' is not a way to pass '{0}': it is ByVal or ByRef.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_PassingIsNotAChoice
data.value: '{0}' stays ByRef: the new procedure writes a value to it that is read after, or VBA passes it only by reference.

data.name: ExtractMethodParameter_OptionalBeforeRequired
data.value: The Optional parameter '{0}' comes before '{1}', which is not Optional: in VBA, the Optional parameters come last.

data.name: ExtractMethod_Title
data.value: Extract method…

data.name: ExtractMethod_DocumentChanged
data.value: The extraction was not made: the document has changed since it was offered. Select the statements again.

data.name: ConvertGoSub_DocumentChanged
data.value: The routine was not converted: the document has changed since it was offered. Ask for the conversion again.

data.name: ConvertGoSub_ConvertAll
data.value: Convert every GoSub routine of the procedure

data.name: ConvertGoSub_ConvertAllDescription
data.value: The routines are converted innermost first, each checked on the code the one before left: all of them, or none. Each one but this one is named after its label.

data.name: ConvertGoSub_RunsAnother
data.value: The GoSub at {1} runs another routine, which is converted first, with every routine of the procedure.

data.name: ConvertGoSub_NotAll
data.value: The routines were not converted: {0} cannot be. {1}

data.name: ConvertGoSub_NameTaken
data.value: The routines were not converted: another one is named {0} already.

data.value: Name

data.value: The name of the new procedure.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_Parameters
data.value: Parameters

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ParametersDescription
data.value: What the new procedure is given, and how.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ParameterName
data.value: Name

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ParameterPassing
data.value: Passing

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ParameterByVal
data.value: A copy of the value: what the new procedure writes to it does not reach the caller.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ParameterByRef
data.value: The variable itself: what the new procedure writes to it reaches the caller.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ReturnValue
data.value: Return value

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ReturnValueDescription
data.value: The variable the new procedure returns, as a Function.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ReturnValueNone
data.value: None

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_RouteExits
data.value: Route the exits

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_RouteExitsDescription
data.value: The new procedure returns where the selection leaves to, and the call goes there.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_Accessibility
data.value: Accessibility

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_AccessibilityDescription
data.value: Where the new procedure can be called from.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_AccessibilityPrivate
data.value: From this module only.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_AccessibilityPublic
data.value: From anywhere in the project; for a class module, through each of its objects.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ReplaceDuplicates
data.value: Replace the duplicates

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_ReplaceDuplicatesDescription
data.value: Each duplicate that is ticked is replaced with a call to the new procedure.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_Duplicates
data.value: Duplicates

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_DuplicatesDescription
data.value: Code written as the selection is, which a call to the new procedure can replace.

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_DuplicateReplace
data.value: Replace

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_DuplicateNeedsPublic
data.value: In another module: replaced only when the new procedure is Public.

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_DuplicateNeedsPublicMember
data.value: In the class: replaced only when the new member is Public.

data.name: ExtractMethodDuplicate_NotADuplicate
data.value: '{0}' is not a duplicate of the selection as it is extracted.

data.name: ExtractMethodDuplicate_NeedsPublic
data.value: The duplicate at {0} is in another module: only a Public procedure can replace it.

data.name: ExtractMethodDuplicate_NeedsPublicMember
data.value: The duplicate at {0} is in the class: only a Public member can replace it.

data.name: ExtractMethodDuplicate_Overlaps
data.value: The duplicate at {0} overlaps what the extraction already changes: it cannot be replaced as well.

data.name: ExtractMethodDuplicate_NotVerified
data.value: The duplicate at {0} cannot be replaced: it would break the code. {1}

data.name: ExtractMethodDuplicate_Replacement
data.value: Replace the duplicate at {0} with a call

data.name: ExtractMethodChoice_AccessibilityUnknown
data.value: '{0}' is not an accessibility the new procedure can have: choose Private or Public.

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_ReadOnly
data.value: Read by the selection, not written.

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_ReadAndWritten
data.value: Read and written by the selection.

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_WrittenOnly
data.value: Written by the selection, and read after it.

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_Array
data.value: An array, which is always passed by reference.

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_UserDefinedType
data.value: A user-defined type, which is always passed by reference.

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_FixedLengthString
data.value: A fixed-length string, which is passed by reference.

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_Static
data.value: A Static local, passed by reference so that it keeps its value.

data.name: ExtractMethodReason_ParamArray
data.value: The procedure's ParamArray.

data.name: ExtractMethodSelection_NoStatement
data.value: The selection holds no whole statement of a procedure's body.

data.name: ExtractMethodSelection_CutsABlock
data.value: The selection cuts the block statement at {1}: select it whole, or only statements inside it.

data.name: ExtractMethodSelection_CutsADirectiveBlock
data.value: The selection cuts an #If block: select it whole, or none of its directives.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_ParamArrayWritten
data.value: The selection writes an element of the ParamArray '{0}' at {1}: a copy passed to a new procedure would lose the write.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_WithTargetIsNotAVariable
data.value: The selection uses a member of the object of the With block at {1}, which names no variable: passing its object would evaluate the expression again.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_ConstantUsedAfter
data.value: The constant '{0}' declared in the selection is used after it, at {1}: the code after the call could not name it.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_JumpIntoTheSelection
data.value: A jump from outside the selection lands in it, at {1}.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_GoSubToOutside
data.value: The GoSub at {1} goes to a routine outside the selection: convert the routine to a procedure first.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_ReturnOfAGoSubOutside
data.value: The Return at {1} returns to a GoSub outside the selection: convert the routine to a procedure first.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_ErrorHandlingChanged
data.value: The On Error at {1} leaves the error handling different from what it was at the start of the selection.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_HandlerOutsideTheSelection
data.value: The On Error GoTo at {1} names a handler outside the selection.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_ResumeOfAnErrorBefore
data.value: The Resume at {1} is about an error raised before the selection: the new procedure has no error of its own to resume.

data.name: ExtractMethodChange_CallerHandlerResumes
data.value: An error handler of the procedure ({0}) can catch an error of the selection: extracted, the error reaches it at the call, where a Resume Next skips the rest of the extracted code and a Resume runs the whole call again.

data.name: ExtractMethodChange_ErlOnly
data.value: An error handler of the procedure ({0}) can catch an error of the selection: only what Erl says changes.

data.name: ExtractMethodChange_ResumeNextOnSomePaths
data.value: The selection runs under On Error Resume Next on some paths and not on others: the new procedure cannot start as all of them do.

data.name: ExtractMethodChange_ErlReportsTheCall
data.value: The selection has line numbers, and an error handler of the procedure ({0}) can catch an error of it: Erl reports the line of the call or, where Erl counts line labels, the last line number before the call.

data.name: ExtractMethodChange_ErrClearedOnEntry
data.value: The selection reads Err or Erl under On Error Resume Next: the On Error Resume Next the new procedure starts with clears them.

data.name: ExtractMethodChange_ObjectReleasedEarlier
data.value: These variables become the new procedure's own: {1}. When one of them holds the last reference to an object, the object is released when the new procedure ends, and its Class_Terminate runs before the code after the call.

data.name: ExtractMethodEdit_NotAReturnCandidate
data.value: '{0}' is not a value the selection gives back.

data.name: ExtractMethodEdit_ExitRoutingDeclined
data.value: The selection leaves the procedure, or a loop or a block around it, and the exits are not routed.

data.name: ExtractMethodEdit_NotAccepted
data.value: The extraction would change what the code does, and the change was not accepted: {0}

data.name: ExtractMethodVerification_Failed
data.value: The extraction was not made: it would break the code. {0}

data.name: ExtractMethodVerification_DoesNotParse
data.value: The edited module would not parse ({0}).

data.name: ExtractMethodVerification_NameDoesNotBind
data.value: A name would declare a variable implicitly ({0}).

data.name: ExtractMethodVerification_NewCompileError
data.value: The edited module would have a compile error it did not have ({0}).

data.name: ExtractMethodVerification_DataFlowDiffers
data.value: The call would not take in, give back or keep for the code after it the same values as the selection.

data.name: ExtractMethodVerification_ExitNotReached
data.value: The call would not leave the procedure for every place the selection left it for.

data.name: ConvertGoSub_Title
data.value: Convert GoSub routine to procedure…

data.name: ConvertGoSub_NoLabel
data.value: There is no GoSub routine here: convert a routine from its label, or from a GoSub that names it.

data.name: ConvertGoSub_NoGoSub
data.value: No GoSub runs '{0}': it starts no routine to convert.

data.name: ConvertGoSub_NotContiguous
data.value: The routine '{0}' is not one run of statements from its label: a jump in it goes back before the label, or it holds code it never runs.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_FallsIntoTheRoutine
data.value: The code at {1} goes on into the routine, which then reaches its Return with no GoSub (run-time error 3), where a call would not.

data.name: ExtractMethodRefusal_OnGoSubInASingleLineIf
data.value: The On…GoSub at {1} runs the routine from a single-line If, where the Select Case it would become cannot be written.

data.name: ExtractMethodEdit_RoutineUsesTheResult
data.value: The routine reads or writes the procedure's result, which each call would have to copy.

data.name: ExtractMethodEdit_RoutineRunsItself
data.value: The routine runs itself: a GoSub in it names it.

data.name: ExtractMethodEdit_RoutineInAWithBlock
data.value: The routine uses the object of a With block it is written in.
